blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — At least four barangays in Macalelon, Quezon have been affected by African Swine Fever (ASF), prompting local authorities to urge hog raisers to remain vigilant and strictly observe precautionary measures to prevent the further spread of the disease. In a public advisory, the Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) said laboratory test results from blood samples confirmed on Nov. 11 that barangays Mabini Ibaba, Amontay, Candangal, and Pinagbayanan tested positive for ASF.
